scope: Private-site viewer data projection, capability scope, RPC discovery, connection admission, credential logs and theme footer
changes: Explicit viewer node, report and theme field allowlists shared by compatibility transports
Backend billing and expiry policy, including independent-share restrictions
Administrator-only RPC introspection and exact build identity
Pre-upgrade private-site WebSocket authorization, source/grant/global quotas and idle deadlines
Separate HTTP capacity for verified Agent, administrator and guest identities
Independently revocable hash-only grants with node, billing, rolling history and expiry scope
HttpOnly capability cookie exchange and clean credential-blind /shared routes
Case-normalized share parameters with ambiguous-key rejection
Private entrance and query credential application-log redaction
Scoped Nginx hardening utility with staged peer verification, rollback and protected old logs
Removed the upstream theme-author footer link; retained license files

validation.audience_build_checks: PASS for both independently compiled guest exports
validation.govulncheck_go_1_27_3: 0 reachable vulnerabilities; 1 module-only advisory with no imported vulnerable package
validation.simulation_limit: Admission-layer role simulation, not 500 real operating systems or a production load attack
validation.local_race_limit: Windows Zig toolchain cannot link the synchronization imports required by the Go race runtime; Linux CI remains the race-test gate
validation.production_ingress: Verified direct IPv4/IPv6 origin denial, normal proxied access, protected credential logs and unchanged containers

rollout: Application fixes require a newly built release. Existing production application and Agent binaries were not replaced during this change.
compatibility: Existing global links remain valid and individually revoke through legacy settings; new links use independent grants. Legacy grant history is limited to the latest 24 hours. New tokens are shown once. Public-site mode intentionally exposes public data without a share; use private-site mode for scoped sharing.
limitations: Recipients can copy permitted monitoring data or forward a still-valid bearer link
An open-source viewer cannot be guaranteed unidentifiable
Cloudflare IP allowlisting does not replace account-specific origin authentication or application authorization
Cloudflare account cache and WAF rules require separate account access to audit
Historical logs were retained in a root-restricted rollback directory instead of erased
